name: Inferno Aegis
blurb: Active: Shyvana  shields herself for a short time, with the shield strength increased for every nearby enemy champion. While it holds, she gains  bonus move speed, increased while facing enemy champions. Inferno Aegis can be recast while the shield holds and does so automatically after it expires or is broken.

effects.description: Active: Shyvana shields herself for 2.5 seconds, with the shield strength increased by 30% for every nearby enemy champion. While it holds, she gains 25% bonus movement speed, increased to 43.75% while facing visible enemy champions.
After 1 second, Inferno Aegis can be recast while the shield holds and does so automatically after it expires or is broken.
Recast: Shyvana consumes the shield to explode, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies.

Dragon Form Bonus: If the explosion hits an enemy champion, Shyvana heals herself for 75 - 214.71 (based on level) (+ 10% bonus AD) (+ 5% AP), increased by 0% - 100% (based on her missing health) for a maximum heal of 150 - 429.41 (based on level) (+ 20% bonus AD) (+ 10% AP).
